data.text:
Real courage, no debate.

During a devastating fire in Mandaue City, Cebu (Philippines), a woman refused to escape without her dogs. As flames closed in, she climbed a ladder, tossed each dog to safety, then hung on until firefighters pulled her to safety.

She survived with minor injuries.
Her dogs survived because she chose love over fear.

Now she’s being called a hero worldwide, and rightly so.

Question: Would you risk your life to save your pets, or would fear take over?

For me,  I’d fight for them if there was any chance at all.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the rally organized by All India Congress Committee at Ram Leela Ground on 14.12.2025 (10:00 AM–04:00 PM), traffic restrictions and diversions will be in place in and around Ram Leela Ground.

📍 AFFECTED ROADS (10:00 AM–07:00 PM):
JLN Marg, Asaf Ali Road, Chaman Lal Marg, Ajmeri Gate, Minto Road & Delhi Gate

📍 KEY RESTRICTIONS:
* No heavy vehicles/buses from Delhi Gate, Minto Road & Ajmeri Gate towards JLN Marg
* Use alternate routes and plan travel in advance

📍 PARKING:
* Cars/Buses : Mata Sundari College Parking
* Buses: Rajghat / Power House Parking

📍 GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
* No roadside parking on affected roads
* Follow Delhi Traffic Police instructions
* Illegally parked vehicles will be towed

📍 Stay updated via Delhi Traffic Police

#DPTrafficAdvisory

REAL COURAGE & LOVE: During a massive fire in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines, this lady, Ei Mei Lee Maningo refused to leave until her dogs were safe ❤️

She survived with minor injuries and her dogs survived because she chose love over fear.

We sincerely thank the Lustre Global Awards Philippines 2025 and Sir Don Cristobal for this incredible recognition. Being named Most Promising and Inspiring Girl Group of the Year is a meaningful milestone for VVINK and our entire team. ✨🫶🏻

As much as we would have loved to personally receive the award, we were caught in traffic from another event in Bulacan.

We also want to thank our management @FlipMusicPH, our coaches, composers, our families, and of course, our VVINKIES, for their continued trust and support.  🎶

We promise to always give our best. Patuloy po kaming magsisikap to be symbols of excellence and innovation. Ipagkalat natin ang tunog na sariling atin! Maraming salamat po, and to God be the glory! 🙏
